correctness.rationale: Multiplication in J=n_4(F_q) has only (XY)13=x12*y23=u, (XY)24=x23*y34=v, (XY)14=x12*y24+x13*y34=w. Six unused input coordinates yield q^6. Writing a=x12,b=x13,c=x23,d=y23,e=y24,f=y34, the cases (a,f) both nonzero / one zero / both zero contribute q(q−1)², q²(q−1)1_{u=0}, q²(q−1)1_{v=0}, and q^4 1_{u=v=w=0}. Independent six-variable enumeration matched all q³ targets over F2,F3,F5 (and source verifier covers F4), confirming q=2 fiber sizes 1664,640,384,128 with multiplicities 1,1,4,2 and total q^12. The four-case algebraic proof establishes all finite prime powers.
